vw_packqty:
CREATE VIEW [dye].[vw_PackQty]

AS

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(50),NEWID()) WProcessNo , a.JobSheetNo,a.ShiftID,j.CustomerID,j.ProdID,j.ColorID,j.ColorNum,a.ProcessID,CAST(a.EndTime AS VARCHAR(30)) AS EndTime,a.EmpID,b.CurrRolls,b.CurrKg,a.Qty,ROUND(CASE WHEN ISNULL(pc.IsAbroad,0)=0 THEN p.Price ELSE p.Price*1.5 END,2) Price ,ROUND((CASE WHEN ISNULL(pc.IsAbroad,0)=0 THEN p.Price ELSE p.Price*1.5 END)*a.Qty/1000,2) AS WorkMoney FROM dye.PackQty a JOIN dye.PackQty1 b ON b.JobSheetNo = a.JobSheetNo AND b.ShiftID = a.ShiftID LEFT JOIN dye.p_Process p ON p.ProcessID = a.ProcessID

LEFT JOIN dye.JobSheet j ON a.JobSheetNo=j.SheetNo

LEFT JOIN dye.p_Customer pc ON j.CustomerID=pc.CustomerID

UNION ALL 

SELECT a.WProcessNo,a.JobSheetNo,a.ShiftID,CustomerID,d.ProdID,d.ColorID,d.ColorNum,a.ProcessID,CONVERT(VARCHAR(30),a.EndTime,120) AS EndTime,b.EmpID,CurrRolls,CurrKg,CurrKg/c.pre AS Qty,p.Price, ROUND((CurrKg/1000)/c.pre,2) AS WorkMoney

FROM dye.WProcess a JOIN dye.JobShiftEmp b ON a.JobSheetNo=b.JobSheetNo AND a.ShiftID=b.ShiftID AND a.ProcessID=b.ProcessID AND a.WProcessNo=b.WProcessNo AND a.ProcessNo=b.ProcessNo

JOIN (SELECT JobSheetNo,ShiftID,ProcessNo,ProcessID,COUNT(ShiftID)pre FROM dye.JobShiftEmp GROUP BY JobSheetNo,ShiftID,ProcessNo,ProcessID)c ON b.JobSheetNo = c.JobSheetNo AND b.ShiftID = c.ShiftID AND b.ProcessNo=c.ProcessNo AND b.ProcessID=c.ProcessID

JOIN dye.JobSheet d ON a.JobSheetNo=d.SheetNo 

JOIN dye.p_Process p ON a.ProcessID=p.ProcessID

WHERE  a.ProcessID='GX73'
